name: Auto-Security Loop
summary: Agents that pentest your app around the clock: a nightly red team attacks a fresh dev sandbox, scans every pull request, patches confirmed findings and audits dependencies weekly.

secrets.name: GH_TOKEN
secrets.why: Clone the repository, open security issues or advisories and push fix branches with gh.

secrets.name: SECURITY_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.why: Signs the GitHub webhooks for pull requests and issues.

secrets.name: SECURITY_TARGET_URLS
secrets.why: Comma-separated URLs you own that the red team may also attack. Empty means sandbox localhost only.
